issue.title: test_preview_modal_resize_recomputes_geometry sees stale 100x30 screen after resize
issue.description:
The resize test expects the modal to observe a 160x60 screen after resize, but the modal still reports the 100x30 baseline: `assert (100, 30) == (160, 60)` at tests/ace/tui/modals/test_preview_panel_modal_geometry.py:155. Found while verifying the fix_ten_master_check_failures plan (unrelated to that change: none of its files touch preview modals, and the node fails identically on the clean master tree).

Repro: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/modals/test_preview_panel_modal_geometry.py::test_preview_modal_resize_recomputes_geometry -q -p no:randomly` on master 7c763a2e7.

Impact: the node is red in every scoped/full lane run, masking real regressions in preview-modal geometry.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails deterministically in isolation on the unchanged clean-master tree (reproduced twice, including via git stash), with a fixed geometry mismatch, not timing.

payload.description: Need the candidate report for the modal resize failure

evidence.note: Relayed by sase-16h.land from PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs sase-16h.1#1 and sase-16h.4#2; independently reproduced: failed (100,30)!=(160,60) in the sase-16h land scoped lane at master 4022cfe59 (tool run 88b57c647bf8edb75888d0ab82941a13) and in Master Gate run 35793653133 at b5e112a2b.
